renewal_failure_transition: If replacement creation fails by expiry, transition status to blocked_expired and record the failure in blockers; do not continue cycles under the expired job.
last_cycle_summary: Cycle 8 delivered the M1 backend-shutdown cleanup slice through PR #13, squash-merged as af7db55 after both required CI runs passed twice (initial commit and review-fix commit). SIGTERM/SIGINT now wake a dedicated shutdown thread via an async-signal-safe self-pipe; it cancels every active run (whose process groups the supervision paths then SIGKILL), waits up to 5s for drain, removes the socket only if it is still the bound inode, and exits 0. Implemented by a Codex gpt-5.6-sol worker (high effort) within a two-file allowlist; its sandbox blocked socket binding, so all red-to-green, parity, stress, and release-binary runtime verification ran in the workspace (runtime demo: grandchild dead 0.03s after SIGTERM, backend exit 0, socket removed). Independent Codex sol review returned 1 blocker / 2 major / 1 minor, all verified and fixed pre-merge by a second sol worker: an atomic shutdown-admission gate ({runs, shutting_down} under one mutex; drain-window start_process now gets a cancelled terminal instead of an orphanable group), FD_CLOEXEC on both self-pipe fds, O_NONBLOCK on the write end, and a pthread_sigmask bracket closing the pre-install signal window. M1 remains active and incomplete for PTYs, pause/resume, waiting-input detection and run stdin, redaction/metadata, durable state, budget expiry, and temporary/worktree cleanup.
